title: citrus × tachibana subf. depressa
intro: Citrus × tachibana subf. depressa, commonly known as sudachi, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family, characterized by its small, green, and highly aromatic fruits. The health benefits of sudachi include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial agent, which can contribute to improved digestive health and reduced risk of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of sudachi include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce pain, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of sudachi include limonene, beta-pinene, and limonene-1,2-dione, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
